primary_object_card.object_statement: A loop-2 senses retest that preserves the original occluded-object task, seed, split, engine and twin semantics while changing only the density update to retain a 0.5 view-local residual, and that reports failing controls without promotion.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: Owner source for the original loop-2 data, seed, split, engine, twin, occluded-slot, Holevo, and control semantics.
Diagnoses recurrent reconvergence and verifies the bounded 0.5 persistent plus 0.5 view-local residual update.
Requires G4 on the real full-visibility task, complementary engine/twin tables with confidence intervals, and exclusion of the both-random confound.

primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: This object is the exact loop-2 held-out perception verdict rerun on the same generated events, object-disjoint split, random seed, occluded slots, engine features, and classical twin features. The only candidate-path change is the visibility-gate fix: after each view, the persistent density is mixed equally with the same view applied from the initial density. All original and new negative controls remain visible, checks may fail, and no result can promote the engine or carrier.

native_terms.fixed update: After each view, mix one half of the recurrently updated persistent density with one half of that view applied from the initial density.
native_terms.occluded verdict: Predict the hidden current-world bit at an event slot where the observation mask omits that bit, using the original loop-2 task construction.
native_terms.both-random confound: A complementarity outcome where neither engine nor twin exceeds its matched chance threshold, which cannot count as useful complementarity or synergy.

weirdness_signature: The source task and split remain unchanged while only the recurrent update differs.
Complementarity excludes both-wrong cells from any evidence of useful joint coverage.
Full visibility must be tested on the real loop-2 task and beat an explicit chance control.
A green visibility diagnosis remains below promotion and may still yield a negative retest.
first_class_fields: seed and object-disjoint train test split
engine and twin held-out occluded predictions
episode-level complementarity table and bootstrap intervals
primary_object_card.domain: The 64-object loop-2 dynamics-on event log with the original seed, object-disjoint train/test split, occlusion masks, and evaluation slots.
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: A diagnostic-only JSON receipt containing exact metrics, bootstrap and permutation intervals, controls, hashes, checks, and promotion_allowed false.
allowed_operations: reuse the original parser, split, feature, probe, and twin semantics
replace only the persistent density update with the verified equal residual mixture
bootstrap held-out objects for confidence intervals
serialize exact source and input hashes
required_invariants: same world data, seed, split, and held-out objects as loop 2
same occluded-object target and twin semantics as loop 2
both-random outcomes never support complementarity or synergy
all negative controls and failed checks remain in the receipt
promotion_allowed remains false regardless of metric outcomes
forbidden_substitutions: raw-view proxy substituted for the loop-2 verdict task
visibility-gate success substituted for full-task success
phi or complementarity label substituted for above-chance joint utility
new seed, split, data, or target substituted for the original semantics
negative_controls: original broken recurrent update comparison lane
frozen engine with observation outcomes forced to zero
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: The fixed update is a bounded adapter into the original loop-2 evaluator; it preserves task semantics, declares its one changed operation, and cannot promote the engine or carrier.
promotion_locks: passing metrics do not admit a carrier or scale-up
visibility success does not erase negative controls

lateral_mappings.label: 0.5 view-local residual
lateral_mappings.target: fixed recurrent density update inside the unchanged loop-2 evaluator
loses: literal identity with the original broken update
preconditions: visibility sanity fix receipt hash matches
broken path remains a comparison lane
lateral_mappings.kill_control: If data, seed, split, targets, features, or control semantics drift from loop 2, invalidate the retest receipt.

lateral_mappings.label: verdict metric suite
lateral_mappings.target: occluded accuracy, complementarity, Holevo persistence, and full-visibility G4
loses: no claim about untested tasks or carrier scaling
preconditions: bootstrap and permutation procedures are seeded
lateral_mappings.kill_control: Any task drift, reuse of an existing result directory, or missing negative control makes the receipt fail closed.

root_constraints: same loop-2 data seed split and verdict semantics
fixed update is exactly 0.5 persistent plus 0.5 view-local density
extended_constraints: memory pressure preflight before torch or qutip

fixation_breakers: retain every negative control even when the fixed lane passes
classify a passing proxy as diagnostic only when the real task fails

loop_contract.repair_rule: Repair the first semantics, control, or receipt-integrity failure before interpreting any metric.
loop_contract.stop_condition: The new result directory contains one fresh fail-closed receipt, or execution stops at a named runtime, memory, source-hash, or semantics blocker.

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question does not provide authorization; this task explicitly authorizes only the requested build and run without commit, deletion, or movement.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Check execution order separately from content: validate sources and memory first, then build, audit, run, and verify the fresh receipt.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: Preserve the original loop-2 task and output baseline while changing only the diagnosed runtime update path.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: For each target claim, name the strongest live falsifier and decisive check, then classify it as killed, open, or survived.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: Name each operation, its observable, and the numeric pass/fail condition in the receipt.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Refuse to merge visibility-gate success with full-task success, and refuse to merge diagnostic results with promotion.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve all source, runtime, and metric questions with local tools before asking the human for anything unrecoverable.

evidence_spine.wizard_runtime: Wizard v4.3 is the current object-preservation and route-truth boundary; legacy v4.2 surfaces are not run.

source_math_locks.preserves: G4 real-task criterion, complementarity requirements, and both-random exclusion
original loop-2 task, seed, split, engine, twin, Holevo, and control semantics

sim_audit_receipts.claim_ceiling: diagnostic verification of one bounded update fix only

evidence_spine.claim_ceiling: diagnostic loop-2 retest only; checks may fail; promotion_allowed false
